main_text.p: observâssem calumniam, eam pro auctorita-te Præsidis corrigere potuisse, fateor quoque: sed non observâsse: neque adhùc videre, pro-testor seriò. Quid igitur ille, de crimine calumniarum mihi impacto, & nondùm purgato? Cur, quòd infra me existimave-rim alio modo, quàm per Respondentes in scenam productos, secùm congredi? Cur mihi ϖληγάς? Didici, per Dei gratiam, convitiis affici; nec vicissim convitiari. Interim dùm κὴ κοπιῶμεν, κὴ ὀνειδιζόμεθα, à Ministerio & laboribus meis sic saltem removendam censui iteratam istam accusationem. Ego me ad Veritatis, quæ secundùm Pietatem est, defensionem obligatum scio, & sentio; ac pro ratione temporis & virium hoc ago. Sed ut Disertationibus ac Disceptationibus adversariis omnibus examinandis & refutandis nequaquàm sufficio; sic neque mihi soli incumbit ista necessitas. Pensum illud in se receperant DD. Respondentes, & absolverunt conatù ac successù prospero. Si ille infra se existimat refutari & doceri à Junioribus; ego fateri non erubesco, me etiàm per ea quæ à Discipulis proponuntur, frequenter proficere. An verò aliis satisfecerit Auctor, & nomina-tim
· Dot mark in the left margin beside "purgato ?" (no printed note text).

page.notes: Greek words are printed in a worn italic and are transcribed as best read; "ϖληγάς" (plēgas, for πληγάς) and the Greek verbs κὴ κοπιῶμεν and κὴ ὀνειδιζόμεθα are doubtful and marked here for checking. The word "observâssem" and the word "Respondentes" are as printed. The page ends mid-word with "nomina-" continuing as "tim" on the last line, which is set right-aligned as a catchword. The margin mark is a dot, not a marginal note text. The page has no page number printed.
